# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 3 tank_api tests pass: snapshot_response_keeps_legacy_chemistry_aliases, chemistry_response_explains_estimate_scope, biology_snapshot_keeps_total_and_stage_breakdown.
- All 11 tank_tui lib tests pass, including: parses_legacy_snapshot_chemistry_field_names, keeps_canonical_snapshot_fields_when_legacy_aliases_are_also_present, parses_enriched_api_snapshot_response, parses_load_response_with_enriched_api_snapshot, parses_load_response_with_legacy_snapshot_chemistry_field_names, overview_labels_tds_and_conductivity_as_estimates, overview_uses_shared_nh3_n_unit_label, estimated_tds_scope_lines_name_included_and_omitted_species.
- All 7 events integration tests pass, including threshold_event_summaries_use_explicit_chemistry_units.
- All 11 concentration_helpers integration tests pass, including tds_helpers_ignore_stale_bicarbonate_cache.
- All 4 tank_harness lib tests pass, including the corrected envelope_reports_non_finite_values test (now exercises temperature_c instead of the recomputed pH).
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -p tank_harness -- -D warnings: all clean, zero warnings.
- Snapshot fields verified with explicit unit suffixes: tan_mg_n_per_l, nh3_mg_n_per_l, nitrite_mg_n_per_l, nitrate_mg_n_per_l, phosphate_mg_p_per_l, dissolved_inorganic_carbon_mg_c_per_l, co2_aq_mmol_per_l, estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l, estimated_conductivity_us_cm (snapshot.rs:30-45).
- Conversion constants centralized in conversions.rs with molar-mass derivations: NO3_PER_N (62.004/14.007), NO2_PER_N (46.005/14.007), NH4_PER_N (18.039/14.007), NH3_PER_N (17.031/14.007), PO4_PER_P (94.971/30.974).
- GH/KH constants named and documented in water.rs: CALCIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MAGNESIUM_AS_CACO3_FACTOR, MG_CACO3_PER_MEQ, MG_CACO3_PER_DEGREE, MOLAR_MASS_CACO3_G_PER_MOL. ESTIMATED_TDS_TO_CONDUCTIVITY_DIVISOR has doc comment explaining the empirical freshwater approximation.
- TDS scope metadata centralized in tank_core water.rs: ESTIMATED_TDS_TRACKED_MAJOR_IONS, ESTIMATED_TDS_OMITTED_CONTRIBUTORS, ESTIMATED_TDS_SCOPE_LINES — re-exported via types/mod.rs and consumed by both API and TUI without duplication.
- TDS/conductivity uses fresh carbonate projection: WaterState::estimated_dissolved_solids() calls projected_carbonate_equilibrium() for a fresh solve each time; TankSnapshot::from_state() shares the same fresh carbonate solve for pH, CO2, and TDS.
- API backward compatibility: insert_legacy_chemistry_fields() backfills all 8 old field names. snapshot_response_json() confirmed used on /snapshot, /time/step, /load, and /scenarios/load endpoints. chemistry_field_semantics, estimated_tds_scope, and legacy_chemistry_aliases metadata included in responses.
- TUI labels: overview.rs renders 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. cond'; chemistry.rs renders 'Est. TDS (7-ion)' and 'Est. conductivity (7-ion)'. Scope lines from ESTIMATED_TDS_SCOPE_LINES displayed on both screens.
- TUI api_client normalize_snapshot_object strips legacy aliases and API metadata (chemistry_field_semantics, estimated_tds_scope, legacy_chemistry_aliases) before deserialization. 6 tests cover all compatibility paths.
- Event summaries use explicit chemistry bases: 'Free ammonia (NH3-N) reached ... mg NH3-N/L' and 'Nitrite-N reached ... mg N/L' (events.rs). NH3_N_DISPLAY_UNIT constant shared across TUI screens.
- co2_aq_mmol_per_l field in TankSnapshotRepr now has #[serde(default)], with regression test snapshot_deserializes_payloads_missing_co2_field confirming old payloads parse correctly.
- envelope_reports_non_finite_values test now exercises temperature_c (which is copied through to TankSnapshot) instead of the recomputed pH, making the test sound.

## Findings and Gaps

- Pre-existing compile error in crates/tank_core/src/systems/light.rs:78 (ambiguous numeric type on .exp() call) blocks cargo test -p tank_core --lib. This is unrelated to this bead — it is in a light attenuation test function. tank_core integration tests (events, concentration_helpers) compile and pass since they don't trigger the lib test target.
- The conversions.rs module (NO3_PER_N, NO2_PER_N, etc.) is public but has no internal callers outside its own test module. It serves as library infrastructure per UNITS.md. Not a correctness defect, but worth noting as a coverage gap for internal use.
- No dedicated end-to-end TUI render test asserts exact screen output; only targeted label, scope-line, and estimate-prefix assertions exist. Acceptable since the TUI is not a stable API surface.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
